comparisonVerdict.rationale: It is the only frame combining a clearly readable armed soldier, a non-zero score with decremented reserve ammo, and near-field targets over the barricade that match the reference's depth staging, though its edge over sample-05 and sample-02 is small enough that I might rank them differently on a second viewing.

samples.biggestGap: Weapon is a scoped SCAR with holo sight and olive sleeve rather than the reference's iron-sighted M4 with black gloves, and the targets sit lower and flatter than the reference's tall floating panels.
samples.evidence: SCORE 0100 with ammo 30/89 and 'HIT 11 TARGETS' shows a shot fired, a hit scored and counters updating; a textured soldier in dark fatigues holding a rifle stands mid-yard beside a red target, with the round barrier, concrete barricade, black lockers, white-railed walkway beam and the grey ramp all present and casting ground shadows.
samples.label: sample-01

samples.biggestGap: Camera sits far back so the whole range collapses into a thin band on the horizon — half the frame is empty tiled floor, unlike the reference where targets and barricades fill the mid-frame.
samples.evidence: SCORE 0150 and 29/90 confirm firing and hit scoring; targets are small red rectangles on visible thin steel stand legs spread across the yard, with round barrier, canopy walkway, ramp and lockers behind them.
samples.label: sample-02

samples.biggestGap: No enemy soldier is legible — only a faint dark sliver behind the left-centre target — where the reference shows a full standing figure with a shadow.
samples.evidence: Untouched start state (SCORE 0000, TIME 60, 30 / 90) with seven red targets at staggered depths, a concrete barricade wall in front, the curved barrier and its cast shadow at left, and the black lockers plus grey ramp on the right.
samples.label: sample-03

samples.biggestGap: The patrolling soldier is essentially absent (a red-brown smudge at the edge of one target), and nothing in the frame shows any gameplay having happened.
samples.evidence: Same start-state frame as its neighbour: SCORE 0000 / TIME 60 / 30 / 90, staggered red panels over the grey barricade, round barrier with contact shadow, lockers, walkway beam and ramp all rendered with clean flat lighting.
samples.label: sample-04

samples.biggestGap: Framing is unbalanced — the leftmost target is clipped by the frame edge and the ramp structure is cut off at the right — so the yard reads narrower and less centred than the reference.
samples.evidence: SCORE 0100 with 29/90 and 'HIT 11 TARGETS' shows shooting and scoring; a clearly modelled soldier in helmet and vest holding a rifle stands left of centre against the dark wall, with round barrier, low concrete wall, lockers and the ramp filling the right.
samples.label: sample-05

samples.biggestGap: No enemy soldier anywhere in frame, and the distant camera makes every target a small chip against the wall instead of the reference's large near panels.
samples.evidence: Fresh state (SCORE 0000, TIME 59, 30 / 90) with eight small red targets on thin steel posts, the cylindrical barrier and its shadow at left, canopy-topped walkway and grey ramp centre-right, and a large pale box structure at right.
samples.label: sample-06

samples.biggestGap: Empty of any enemy or gameplay evidence, with the same distant framing that leaves the bottom half of the screen as bare tiled concrete.
samples.evidence: Pixel-for-pixel the same untouched range view as its sibling: SCORE 0000 / TIME 59 / 30 / 90, eight post-mounted red targets, round barrier, canopy walkway, ramp, lockers, and the rifle with EOTech reticle at lower right.
samples.label: sample-07

samples.biggestGap: The viewmodel has sunk out of frame — no forearm or glove visible, just the receiver in the corner — versus the reference's fully presented rifle and gloved hands anchoring the lower right.
samples.evidence: SCORE 0150, TIME 56 and 30 / 89 indicate several hits and a reload cycle, and a tiny brown soldier figure is visible beside the walkway supports; the rifle is caught mid-animation, dropped low with the arm almost entirely below the frame.
samples.label: sample-08
